source_description_html:
CARVED FROM BILLET ALUMINUM THIS TAIL TIDY PERFECTLY INTEGRATES WITH THE LINES OF THE V4 PANIGALE. FITS 2018+ V4/ V4S/ V4R/ V4 SPECIALE/ V4S CORSE/V4 SUPERLEGGERA. USES FACTORY OEM ELECTRICAL CONNECTORS. NO CUTTING/SPLICING REQUIRED. PLUG AND PLAY

  • Integrated super bright turn-signals and plate light.
  • There are 2 plate bracket options a more traditional 90° bracket and a tucked back bracket that is parallel with the under-tail. 
  • Ships with Black Stainless Fasteners.
  • Uses factory electrical Connectors. 
  • An easy 3 bolt install no swapping of parts. 


** The Plate light is not compatible with the angled back bracket.
